title: Part 7 单篇阅读
goal: 邮件、广告、通知；定位与同义替换

steps.title: 一封招聘邮件
lines: To Karen Wu, from Daniel Moss in Human Resources. Subject: Your application.
收件人：凯伦·吴；发件人：人力资源部丹尼尔·莫斯；主题：您的申请
Dear Ms. Wu, thank you for applying for the marketing manager vacancy.
吴女士：感谢您申请市场经理一职。
I am pleased to inform you that you have been shortlisted for an interview.
很高兴通知您，您已入围面试名单。
The interview will be held on March 3 at 10 a.m. Please bring copies of your credentials.
面试定于 3 月 3 日上午 10 点，请带上您的资格证书复印件。
If this time is not convenient, please let me know by February 25.
如果这个时间不方便，请在 2 月 25 日前告诉我。
steps.note: Part 7 共 54 题，单篇阅读约 29 题，其中邮件和信件最多。题目几乎都是同一套：目的是什么、谁写给谁、要求对方做什么、附了什么、什么是正确的。

steps.title: 邮件的结构 = 题目的位置
what: 邮件头（To / From / Date / Subject）：问身份、日期、主题的题，答案常在这里。
第一段：目的 —— I am writing to… / I'd like to… / Thank you for… / I am pleased to inform you…
中间段：细节 —— 时间、地点、条件、问题。
最后一段：请求和下一步 —— Please… / I would appreciate it if… / Feel free to… / I look forward to…；还有附件：attached / enclosed
why: “What is the purpose of the e-mail?” 看第一段；“What is Ms. Wu asked to do?” 看 Please 句；“What is enclosed?” 找 attached / enclosed —— 不用通读就能定位。
zh: 中文邮件常先寒暄铺垫、最后才说目的；英文商务邮件目的在第一两句，要求在最后，这个规律非常稳定。
ex: I am writing to inform you that your application has been received.
特此通知，您的申请已收到。
I would appreciate it if you could send your references by Friday.
如果您能在周五前寄来推荐信，我将不胜感激。
Please find attached a copy of the job description.
附件是职位描述，请查收。
err: 目的题去最后一段找。
The purpose of an e-mail is usually stated in the first paragraph.
目的在开头，请求在结尾
steps.sum: 目的看开头、请求看 Please、附件找 attached / enclosed；身份和日期看邮件头。

drill.q: Dear Mr. Lee, I am writing to inform you that our sales manager, Ms. Holt, has resigned. —— What is the purpose of the letter?
Last paragraph: Please find enclosed a copy of your contract. —— What is included with the letter?
Last paragraph: I would appreciate it if you could confirm your attendance by Monday. —— What is the reader asked to do?

steps.title: NOT / true 题：一个选项一个选项回文核对
what: What is NOT mentioned / NOT true?：四个选项里三个在文中找得到，找找不到或矛盾的那个。
What is true / indicated about…?：只有一个能在文中找到依据，其他三个是“没提到”或“说反了”。
做法：先读选项，抓每个选项的关键词，回原文逐个打勾；这类题最花时间，可以放到同一篇的最后做。
why: NOT 题的正确答案经常是“听起来合理、但文中根本没提”的选项，所以不能凭常识判断。
zh: 中国考生做 NOT 题容易漏看 NOT（大写也会看漏），选成了“文中提到的”。看到 NOT 先在草稿上画个圈。
ex: The position requires five years of experience, expertise in data analysis, and a strong aptitude for problem-solving. —— NOT mentioned: a university degree
该职位要求五年经验、数据分析专长和较强的解决问题能力。（没提学历）
err: NOT 题选了文中写到的五年经验。
For a NOT question, choose the option that the text does not mention.
NOT 题找“没提到”的
steps.sum: NOT 题：三个打勾、一个找不到；true 题：一个找得到依据；都要回原文核对。

drill.q: Applicants must have a driver's license and at least two years of sales experience. Knowledge of Spanish is preferred. —— What is NOT a requirement for the job?
The interviewer will be Ms. Ramos, our head of recruiting. Interviews last about forty minutes. —— What is true about the interview?
o: It will be with the company president.
It will take less than an hour.

drill.q: Annual appraisals take place in December. Employees meet with their managers to discuss goals for the coming year. —— What is indicated about the appraisals?

steps.text: I am pleased to inform you that you have been shortlisted for an interview.
steps.zh: 很高兴通知您，您已入围面试名单。
steps.focus: pleased to 连读，shortlisted 重音在 short

steps.q: There is a ___ in the accounting department because Mr. Hall retired.
Ms. Ito handed in her letter of ___ yesterday.
Only five ___ were invited to a second interview.
We need someone with ___ in international law.
The company plans to ___ twenty new engineers this year.
He decided to ___ from his position to start his own business. (辞职)
a: resign

steps.a: You have been shortlisted for an interview.
I am writing to inform you that your application has been received.

steps.zh: 如果这个时间不方便，请告诉我。
a: If this time is not convenient, please let me know.
If this time isn't convenient, please let me know.
Please let me know if this time is not convenient.

points: 重点：邮件结构 —— 目的看第一段，请求看 Please，附件找 attached / enclosed，身份日期看邮件头。
重点：NOT / true 题 —— 读选项抓关键词，逐个回原文核对；NOT 题找“没提到”的。

steps.title: 一则活动广告
lines: Riverside Charity Fundraiser — Saturday, May 12, 6 p.m., Grand Hotel Banquet Hall
河畔慈善募捐晚会 —— 5 月 12 日周六晚 6 点，格兰德酒店宴会厅
Enjoy a three-course dinner, live music and a silent auction.
享用三道菜晚餐、现场音乐和无声拍卖。
Admission: $60. Children under 12 are admitted free of charge.
门票：60 美元，12 岁以下儿童免费入场。
Vegetarian meals are available. Please tell us about any dietary needs when you book.
提供素食。如有饮食需求，请在预订时告知。
This event is sponsored by Lakeside Bank. All profits go to the city children's hospital.
本活动由湖畔银行赞助，所有收益将捐给市儿童医院。
steps.note: 广告和通知篇幅短，但信息密：价格、条件、期限、例外。题目最爱考条件和例外：谁免费、什么时候前、至少多少。

steps.title: 广告和通知的四块信息
what: ① 标题 / 第一句：卖什么、办什么活动 → What is being advertised? / What is the purpose of the notice?
② 卖点：特色、服务内容 → What is offered?
③ 条件：价格、期限、资格、例外 → How can customers receive a discount? / Who can attend?
④ 行动：怎么报名、联系谁、去哪里 → What should interested people do?
why: 广告题第一题几乎都是“广告的是什么”，第一行通常就有答案；但要注意选项会换说法：Grand Hotel Banquet Hall → an event at a hotel。
zh: 中文广告爱用大字和感叹号；英文广告则常用祈使句（Enjoy… / Book now… / Call today…），每个祈使句后面就是一个可考点。
ex: Book your holiday luncheon with us and get free beverages for your whole group.
在我们这里预订节日午宴，全团免费提供饮品。
Volunteers are needed to help serve refreshments at the marathon.
马拉松活动需要志愿者帮忙提供茶点。
To sign up, visit our website or call 555-0182.
报名请访问我们的网站或致电 555-0182。
err: What is being advertised? —— 选第一段没出现的“酒店招聘”。
The advertisement is for a fundraising dinner.
答案在标题和第一句
steps.sum: 标题 = 卖什么；卖点 = 提供什么；条件 = 价格期限例外；行动 = 怎么报名。

drill.q: Bella Catering — We cater weddings, office parties and business luncheons. Vegetarian and gluten-free menus available. —— What kind of business is advertised?
Volunteers needed! Help us serve refreshments at the Spring Fun Run on April 3. Sign up at the community center by March 25. —— What should interested people do?
The library's annual book sale is sponsored by Green Leaf Bookstore. —— What is indicated about Green Leaf Bookstore?

steps.title: 限定词陷阱：only / all / at least / up to / except
what: 范围：all（全部）vs some / most（部分）；only（只有）；except（除了）
数量：at least（至少）/ up to（最多）/ no more than（不超过）/ over（超过）
义务：must / be required to（必须）vs may / be encouraged to（可以 / 鼓励）
why: 错误选项常把“部分”改成“全部”、把“鼓励”改成“必须”、把“最多 50%”改成“50%”。读选项时要把这些小词和原文对一对。
zh: 中文“最多打五折”“至少五人”也有限定，但中国考生做题时常只看数字不看限定词，被 up to / at least 骗。
ex: Save up to 50% on selected items.
部分商品最多可省 50%。
Groups of at least ten receive a discount.
十人及以上团体可享折扣。
Admission is free for all members except on holidays.
除节假日外，会员一律免费入场。
err: 原文 Save up to 50% on selected items → 选项 All items are half price.
Some items are discounted by as much as 50%.
up to + selected → 不是全部都打五折
原文 Guests are encouraged to bring a dish → 选项 Guests must bring food.
Guests are invited to bring food if they wish.
encouraged ≠ must
steps.sum: 对比原文和选项里的小词：all / some、only、at least / up to、must / may、except。

drill.q: Ad: “Up to 30% off all winter coats this weekend.” Which statement is true?
o: The sale lasts for a month.
Some coats may be discounted less than 30%.

drill.q: Notice: “Admission to the museum is free on Sundays, except for special exhibitions.” Which statement is true?
o: The museum is free every day.
Visitors pay for special exhibitions on Sundays.
The museum is closed on Sundays.

drill.q: “Staff are encouraged to attend the banquet.” This means the banquet is

steps.text: This event is sponsored by Lakeside Bank. All profits go to the city children's hospital.
steps.zh: 本活动由湖畔银行赞助，所有收益捐给市儿童医院。
steps.focus: sponsored 重音在 SPON；profits 尾音 ts

steps.q: The hotel provides ___ for conferences, including meals and drinks.
Hot and cold ___ will be served during the break.
Please let us know about any ___ restrictions, such as allergies.
Our company will ___ the local marathon this year.
The school held a ___ to raise money for new computers.
___ to the park is free for children under five. (入场)
a: Admission

steps.a: Children under 12 are admitted free of charge.
Vegetarian meals are available on request.

steps.zh: 我们需要志愿者在活动中帮忙提供茶点。
a: We need volunteers to help serve refreshments at the event.
Volunteers are needed to help serve refreshments at the event.

points: 重点：广告四块 —— 标题（卖什么）、卖点、条件（价格期限例外）、行动（怎么报名）。
重点：限定词陷阱 —— all / some、only、at least / up to、must / encouraged、except。

steps.title: 一份出差日程
lines: Itinerary for Mr. James Ford — Sales Conference, Vancouver
詹姆斯·福特先生日程 —— 温哥华销售大会
Mon 9:00 Arrive at Terminal 2 · 14:00 Hotel check-in · 19:00 Welcome dinner
周一 9:00 抵达 2 号航站楼 · 14:00 入住酒店 · 19:00 欢迎晚宴
Tue 8:30 Conference opens · 12:00 Lunch with clients · 16:00 Ferry tour of the harbor*
周二 8:30 大会开幕 · 12:00 与客户午餐 · 16:00 乘渡轮游港*
Wed 10:00 Sightseeing with a tour guide · 15:00 Depart from Terminal 2
周三 10:00 导游带领观光 · 15:00 从 2 号航站楼离开
* Optional. Please book in person at the hotel front desk. Per diem: $75 a day for meals.
* 自选项目，请到酒店前台当面预订。每日餐补：75 美元。
steps.note: 表格、日程、价目表、发票、订单是 Part 7 的第三大类。文字少，但星号、脚注、表头常藏着答案。

steps.title: 表格题：先看表头和脚注，再按行列定位
what: ① 先看标题和表头：这是什么表（日程 / 价目 / 订单）、每一列是什么。
② 题目里的关键词（Tuesday / ferry / $75）→ 在表里找到那一行，再读需要的那一列。
③ 一定看脚注：* Optional / ** Subject to change / Prices do not include tax —— 很多题就考这一行。
why: 表格题看起来简单，错误多来自“没看脚注”和“看错行”。用手指（或光标）对着行读，别跳行。
zh: 中国考生习惯把表格当“附带信息”扫一眼就过，但托业表格题的答案往往在最小的那行字里。
ex: Ferry tour of the harbor* —— * Optional. Please book in person.
渡轮游港是自选项目，要当面预订。
Room rates do not include breakfast or parking.
房价不含早餐和停车。
err: 看到 Ferry tour，就认为所有人都要参加。
The ferry tour is optional, according to the note.
脚注说是自选
steps.sum: 表头 → 行 → 列 → 脚注；星号和小字一定要读。

drill.q: Based on the itinerary above, what is true about the ferry tour?
Based on the itinerary above, when will Mr. Ford leave Vancouver?
Price list: Harbor cruise $45 · Lunch cruise $70 · Sunset cruise $85. *Children half price. —— How much would one child pay for the lunch cruise?

steps.title: 交叉信息：正文的一句 + 表格的一行
what: 很多表格会配一段说明或一封邮件。题目会让你把两处的信息合起来：
邮件：I'll join you the day after the conference opens. + 日程：Conference opens Tuesday → 答案 Wednesday
邮件：I'd like the cheapest option. + 价目表 → 找最便宜的那一行
这种题的答案不会在任何一处直接写出来，必须换算。
why: 这是从单篇过渡到多篇阅读（第三学期）的关键能力。题干里有 the day after / the cheapest / the second / instead of 时，就要准备“对表”。
zh: 中文阅读题很少要求跨段计算，托业会，而且是故意的。
ex: “My flight lands two hours before the welcome dinner.” + Welcome dinner 19:00 → lands at 17:00
飞机在欢迎晚宴前两小时降落 → 17:00
“Because of jet lag, I'll skip the first activity on Wednesday.” + Wed 10:00 Sightseeing → he will miss the sightseeing
因为时差，周三第一个活动不参加 → 错过观光
err: “I'll skip the first activity on Wednesday.” → 选 He will not attend the conference.
He will not go sightseeing on Wednesday.
要在表里找到周三第一个活动
steps.sum: 看到 the day after / the cheapest / the first 等，就把正文和表格对起来算。

drill.q: Schedule: Room A — Budget meeting 9:00 · Room B — Training 11:00 · Room C — Client visit 14:00. E-mail: “I'll be in the room where the training is held.” —— Where will the writer be?
Tour prices: City walk $20 · Landmark bus tour $35 · Night cruise $50. E-mail: “Please book me the second most expensive tour.” —— Which tour will be booked?
Hotel note: Wake-up calls can be requested until 11 p.m. Guest: “I need a call at 6 a.m. but I'll be back at midnight.” —— What should the guest do?

steps.text: Please book the ferry tour in person at the hotel front desk.
steps.zh: 请到酒店前台当面预订渡轮游。

steps.q: Our flight leaves from ___ 3, so we should go to that building.
You can take the ___ across the river to the island.
The Eiffel Tower is one of the most famous ___ in the world.
Traffic is heavy during ___, so leave early.
Employees on business trips receive a ___ of $60 for meals.
The project was finished two weeks ___ of schedule.
a: ahead

steps.a: Please book in person at the hotel front desk.
steps.zh: 请到酒店前台当面预订。

steps.a: Children under twelve pay half price.

steps.zh: 因为时差，我周三上午不参加观光。
a: Because of jet lag, I will skip the sightseeing on Wednesday morning.
Because of jet lag, I won't go sightseeing on Wednesday morning.
Due to jet lag, I will not join the sightseeing on Wednesday morning.

points: 出行词：per diem、terminal、ferry、cruise、sightseeing、landmark、tour guide、wake-up call、jet lag、rush hour、ahead of schedule、in person。
重点：表格题 —— 表头 → 行 → 列 → 脚注，星号小字必读。
重点：交叉信息 —— the day after / the cheapest 等要把正文和表格对起来算。

steps.title: 原文和选项说的是同一件事
lines: Text: The board has decided to put off the vote until next month.
原文：董事会决定把投票推迟到下个月。
Option: The vote has been postponed.
选项：投票被延期了。
Text: Ms. Kim will take over as head of sales when Mr. Baker retires.
原文：贝克先生退休后，金女士将接任销售主管。
Option: Ms. Kim will replace Mr. Baker.
选项：金女士将接替贝克先生。
steps.note: Part 7 的正确选项几乎从不照抄原文。短语动词 ↔ 单词，是最常见的替换方式。掌握这一组，阅读速度和正确率都会明显提高。

steps.title: 短语动词 ↔ 正式单词
what: put off = postpone / delay　take over = replace / assume responsibility for　look into = investigate / examine
carry out = conduct / perform　turn down = reject / decline　go over = review / check
hand in = submit　set up = establish / arrange / install　run out of = have no more / use up
account for = explain / make up (a share)　keep track of = monitor / record　make up for = compensate for
why: 原文用口语化的短语动词，选项用正式的单词，或者反过来。两边都认识，才能一眼看出是同一件事。
zh: 中文的“推迟”“接手”“调查”是一个词，英语常用“动词 + 小品词”，小品词一换意思全变（turn down 拒绝 / turn up 出现）。
ex: We are looking into the cause of the delay. = We are investigating the delay.
我们正在调查延误的原因。
The survey was carried out last month. = The survey was conducted last month.
调查是上个月进行的。
Online sales account for 40% of our revenue.
网上销售占我们营收的 40%。
err: The manager turned down the offer. → The manager accepted the offer.
The manager turned down the offer, so the manager rejected it.
turn down = 拒绝
We ran out of paper. → We ordered extra paper.
We ran out of paper, so we had no paper left.
run out of = 用完
steps.sum: put off=postpone · take over=replace · look into=investigate · carry out=conduct · turn down=reject · go over=review · hand in=submit。

drill.q: Text: “The city has turned down the proposal for a new stadium.” Which option means the same?
Text: “Please go over the contract before Friday's meeting.” What is the reader asked to do?
Text: “The store has run out of the blue model.” What is true?
o: The blue model is on sale.
The blue model is the most popular.
The blue model is currently unavailable.

drill.q: Text: “Mr. Ortiz will take over the Tokyo office in April.” What will Mr. Ortiz do?

steps.title: “closest in meaning” 题：一词多义看语境
what: Part 7 每套有 2–4 道：The word “…” in paragraph 2, line 3, is closest in meaning to
考的都是一词多义的常见词，四个选项往往都是它的某个意思，只有一个符合这里的语境：
address：地址 / 演讲 / 处理（address a problem = deal with）　cover：覆盖 / 支付（cover the cost = pay for）/ 报道 / 包括
run：跑 / 经营（run a store = manage）/ 运行　issue：问题 / 期刊的一期 / 发行　terms：条件 / 术语 / 学期
why: 做法：把四个选项代回原句，读一遍，哪个意思通顺就选哪个。不要选“这个词最常见的意思”。
zh: 中国考生背单词通常只背第一个意思，这类题正是考“第二、第三个意思”。
ex: The company will cover the cost of your travel. (cover = pay for)
公司将承担你的差旅费用。
We need to address this issue quickly. (address = deal with)
我们需要尽快处理这个问题。
Ms. Lin runs a small catering business. (runs = manages)
林女士经营一家小餐饮公司。
err: “The insurance covers water damage.” covers = reports on
The insurance covers water damage, which means it includes water damage.
这里 cover = 包括
steps.sum: 代回原句读一遍；常考：address = deal with，cover = pay for / include，run = manage，issue = problem / edition。

drill.q: “Our manager will address the staff at nine.” The word “address” is closest in meaning to
“The March issue of the magazine features local chefs.” The word “issue” is closest in meaning to
“Your membership covers entry to all events.” The word “covers” is closest in meaning to

steps.text: Ms. Kim will take over as head of sales when Mr. Baker retires.
steps.zh: 贝克先生退休后，金女士将接任销售主管。
steps.focus: take over 连读，重音在 over

steps.q: The meeting has been ___ until next Tuesday because the director is sick.
Technicians will ___ the new computers on Monday.
Please ___ your timesheets by 5 p.m. on Friday.
The police are ___ the cause of the fire.
It's hard to ___ all our expenses without a spreadsheet.
We worked on Saturday to make ___ for the lost time.
a: up

steps.a: Online sales account for forty percent of our revenue.
steps.zh: 网上销售占我们营收的百分之四十。

steps.a: The survey was carried out last month.

steps.zh: 董事会决定把投票推迟到下个月。
a: The board decided to put off the vote until next month.
The board has decided to postpone the vote until next month.
The board decided to postpone the vote until next month.

points: 短语动词：put off、take over、look into、carry out、turn down、go over、hand in、set up、run out of、account for、keep track of、make up for。
重点：短语动词 ↔ 正式词 —— put off = postpone，look into = investigate，carry out = conduct，turn down = reject，go over = review。
重点：closest in meaning —— 一词多义，代回原句；address / cover / run / issue / terms。

steps.title: 一则产品召回通知
lines: Notice to Customers: Voluntary Recall of the Model K2 Coffee Maker
顾客通知：K2 型咖啡机主动召回
During a routine quality control inspection, we found a defect in one component of a small batch of K2 coffee makers.
在一次例行质检中，我们发现一小批 K2 咖啡机的一个部件有缺陷。
In the event of overheating, the handle may become hot. No injuries have been reported.
如果过热，把手可能变烫。目前尚无受伤报告。
If your coffee maker's serial number begins with 22B, please stop using it and contact us. We will replace it at no extra charge.
如果您的咖啡机序列号以 22B 开头，请停止使用并与我们联系，我们将免费为您更换。
steps.note: Part 7 单篇实战：先看题，再按题型定位。一篇通知 2–4 题，控制在 2–3 分钟。

steps.title: Part 7 的做题流程
what: ① 先看题（不看选项）：判断题型 —— 目的、细节、NOT / true、推断、词义、句子插入。
② 按题型定位：目的看开头，细节用关键词扫读，词义题直接去指定行。
③ 回原文找依据，再看选项：找到原句后，在选项里找它的同义替换。
④ 时间：阅读 75 分钟，Part 5–6 用 20–25 分钟，Part 7 至少留 50 分钟；一题卡住超过 1 分钟就先猜一个、做标记。
why: 先看题能让你“带着目的读”。单篇的问题顺序大致和原文顺序一致，第一题在前面、最后一题在后面（NOT / true 题除外）。
托业不扣分，任何一题都不要空着。
zh: 中国考生习惯“先把文章读懂再做题”，在托业的时间压力下行不通。要做的是“为题目找证据”。
ex: Q: Why was the notice written? → 看第一句：Voluntary Recall of the Model K2
问目的 → 看标题和第一句
Q: What should customers with serial number 22B do? → 扫 22B → please stop using it and contact us
问细节 → 用 22B 定位
err: 先把整篇读两遍，再看题。
Read the questions first, then find the answers in the text.
先看题，再定位
一道难题想了三分钟。
If a question takes more than a minute, guess and move on.
托业不扣分，先猜再走
steps.sum: 先看题 → 判题型 → 定位 → 找同义替换；卡住一分钟就先猜。

drill.q: Based on the notice, why was the notice written?
o: To inform customers about a product problem
To advertise a new coffee maker

drill.q: Based on the notice, what will the company do for affected customers?
o: Repair the product for a small fee
Give a full refund in cash
Provide a new product free of charge
drill.e: replace it at no extra charge → provide a new product free of charge。

drill.q: Based on the notice, what is indicated about the defect?
o: It has not caused any injuries.
It affects all K2 coffee makers.
drill.e: No injuries have been reported；a small batch ≠ all；found during an inspection ≠ reported by customers。

steps.title: 推断题：What is suggested / implied / most likely
what: 答案文中没有直接写，但能从一两句话推出来。
正确选项 = 原文信息的合理延伸（换说法、合起来、或者反面）：a small batch → Most K2 coffee makers are not affected.
错误选项 = 常识上合理、但文中没有依据（The company will stop making coffee makers.）或推过头（All customers must return their products.）
why: 判断标准：能不能在原文里指出“我是根据这一句推出来的”。指不出来，就是推过头。
zh: 中国考生容易用常识或个人经验补充，选出“现实中可能如此”的选项。托业只认文中依据。
ex: “The company is known for its dependable products.” → It is suggested that the company has a good reputation.
该公司以产品可靠闻名。→ 暗示公司口碑好。
“All suppliers must comply with the new safety rules by June.” → Some suppliers may need to make changes.
所有供应商须在六月前遵守新规。→ 有些供应商可能需要做调整。
err: 原文：a small batch has a defect → 选 The company will close its factory.
A small batch has a defect, so most products are probably safe.
推断不能超出原文依据
steps.sum: 推断 = 能指出依据句的延伸；没有依据、推过头的都不选。

drill.q: “Prices are subject to change without notice.” What is implied?
o: Prices may go up or down.

drill.q: “Because of high demand, delivery may take up to three weeks.” What is suggested about the product?
“Lambert & Sons, a reputable firm with forty years of experience, will carry out the inspection.” What is suggested about Lambert & Sons?
o: It is trusted in its field.

steps.text: During a routine quality control inspection, we found a defect in one component.
steps.zh: 在一次例行质检中，我们发现一个部件有缺陷。
steps.focus: defect 名词重音可在 DE，component 重音在 PO

steps.q: Each ___ of products is checked before shipping.
The engine is the most important ___ of the car.
All factories must ___ the new safety regulations.
___ fire, please use the stairs, not the elevator.
Our ___ team checks every product before it leaves the factory.
The building will be ___ by city officials next week. (检查)
a: inspected

steps.a: We will replace it at no extra charge.

steps.zh: 所有价格如有变动，恕不另行通知。
a: All prices are subject to change without notice.
Prices are subject to change without notice.

points: 质量词：defect、component、batch、quality control、inspect、inspection、comply with、be subject to、in the event of、at no extra charge、dependable、reputable。
重点：Part 7 流程 —— 先看题、判题型、定位、找同义替换；卡住一分钟就猜。
重点：推断题 —— 能指出依据句的延伸才对；没依据、推过头的不选。
单元总结：邮件看结构、广告看条件、表格看脚注和交叉信息、选项看同义替换。

lessons.title: 单元阅读：Job Posting: Event Coordinator

steps.title: Job Posting: Event Coordinator
steps.note: TOEIC Part 7 式的阅读：先看题目再读文章，带着问题找答案。先关掉译文读。
lines: Harbor View Hotel — Event Coordinator (Full-time)
海景酒店 —— 活动协调员（全职）
Harbor View Hotel, a reputable four-star hotel in downtown Seattle, is looking for an experienced event coordinator.
海景酒店是西雅图市中心一家口碑良好的四星级酒店，现招聘一名有经验的活动协调员。
The successful applicant will plan banquets, business luncheons and fundraisers, and work closely with our catering team.
录用者将负责策划宴会、商务午宴和募捐活动，并与我们的餐饮团队紧密合作。
He or she will also keep track of event budgets and deal with clients' dietary requests.
此人还需管理活动预算，并处理客户的饮食需求。
Requirements: at least three years of experience in hotel or event management, and excellent communication skills.
要求：至少三年酒店或活动管理经验，出色的沟通能力。
Knowledge of a second language is preferred but not required.
懂第二语言者优先，但非必需。
We offer a competitive salary, health insurance, and free meals during shifts.
我们提供有竞争力的薪酬、医疗保险以及值班期间的免费餐食。
To apply, send your résumé and two references to Ms. Laura Chen in Human Resources by April 30.
申请者请于 4 月 30 日前将简历和两封推荐信发送至人力资源部的劳拉·陈女士。
Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview in early May.
入围者将于五月初接到面试通知。
Please note that we are unable to reply to every application.*
请注意，我们无法逐一回复所有申请。*
* Applicants who are not contacted by May 15 may assume the position has been filled.
* 5 月 15 日前未接到通知的申请者，可视为职位已招满。

steps.q: What is the purpose of the posting?
What is NOT mentioned as a duty of the job?
steps.e: NOT 题：plan banquets / luncheons、keep track of budgets、deal with dietary requests 都写了，培训厨房员工没提。

steps.q: What is true about a second language?
o: It is helpful but not necessary.
It is required for the job.
steps.e: preferred but not required —— 限定词题。

steps.q: The phrase "keep track of" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
What is suggested about applicants who hear nothing by May 15?
steps.e: 看星号脚注：may assume the position has been filled。

steps.zh: 入围者将于五月初接到面试通知。
a: Shortlisted applicants will be contacted for an interview in early May.
Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview in early May.

points: Part 7 招聘广告：职位 → 职责 → 要求 → 待遇 → 申请方式 → 脚注。
限定词：at least、preferred but not required；同义替换：keep track of = monitor。

extra.q: Dear Ms. Park, I am writing to confirm your reservation for the banquet hall on June 5. —— What is the purpose of the letter?
“Save up to 40% on selected laptops.” Which statement is true?
o: Laptops are free with a purchase.

extra.q: Schedule: Mon — Training · Tue — Site visit · Wed — Report due. E-mail: “I'll be away the day before the report is due.” When will the writer be away?
Text: “The company has decided to put off the launch.” Which option means the same?
o: The launch has been canceled for good.

“Staff are encouraged to attend the workshop.” What is true?
Applicants need a degree in finance and three years of experience. —— What is NOT mentioned as a requirement?
“The ferry runs every thirty minutes.” The word “runs” is closest in meaning to

extra.zh: 请在周五前提交您的报告。
a: Please hand in your report by Friday.
Please submit your report by Friday.
